intro.en: His hands keep working on the knot as his eyes lift to the camera. A shared joke eases the moment before setting off.

tip.en: Match the lace tension on both shoes before starting.
tip.de: Vor dem Start die Schnürung an beiden Schuhen ähnlich fest einstellen.
